parameters.prompt: The exact flying bat in the reference performs ONE ordinary screech attack while hovering in place. From the hovering pose it pulls the head back and raises the wings, then thrusts the head forward toward screen left with the mouth wide open in a screech while the wings sweep down, holds for a brief moment, then closes the mouth and returns to the exact original hovering pose and holds it. Keep the same three-quarter left view, fur, ears and wing shape. Exactly two wings. No flying across the frame, turning around, diving, second attack, extra limbs, sound waves, rings. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, liquid, spray, projectile, particles, dust, shadow or text.
